about: With a background in system administration and a foundation in Computer Science and Entrepreneurship, I’ve been building software professionally since 2016—starting with freelance PHP and JavaScript work in the fintech space. Over the years, I’ve contributed to a range of impactful projects across consulting and in-house teams, with a focus on scalable Salesforce solutions that are built to last.

I’m especially interested in solving the kinds of software problems that create friction for users. My work centers on designing intuitive, reliable systems that help people work more efficiently with less frustration. Today, I’m part of the product team at GoMeddo in the Netherlands, where I build tools that help businesses manage complex scheduling workflows on and around Salesforce.
Outside of work, I love playing music (guitar, bass, sax), traveling, running, experimenting with 3D printing, and exploring Utrecht by bike with my wife, Rachel.
